response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT t.transref, t.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM transaction_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE t.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, avg_anlycount - overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS above_kept_avg FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST, transref LIMIT 10
